title: crux run-work witness (format_version 1)
description: The record of files a run wrote and later passes as council subjects: for each, the repository-relative path and the sha256 of the bytes the run wrote, appended by the vendored witness writer (crux/scripts/run-work-witness.py) at the step that wrote them. Lives at <run_dir>/run-work-witness.json, never under council/. It is never council evidence. The council runner returns the `commit-run-work` repair for a dirty subject only when the subject's working-tree bytes equal the latest entry for its path; the conductor then commits exactly those bytes, path-limited, after re-checking them.
